tools.name: coder_library_search
tools.description: Search the region-specific Aily Coder library catalog for the active project. The catalog is loaded only from libraries-coder-index.json under the main application's selected region resource. Results expose compatibility, activeArchitectures, compatibleAlternatives for a single incompatible match, installed, installedVersion, and managed. Treat alternatives as metadata-ranked candidates and verify their APIs before recommendation. Copy libraryRef and version exactly for installation; for removal use installedVersion and proceed only when installed=true and managed=true. Ignore legacy @aily-project/lib-* root dependencies and node_modules copies even when present; do not use Blockly library package names or sources.

query.description: Prefer an exact library name when known. Additional functionality keywords are ranking hints; verify actual capabilities from result metadata and the installed API.

forceRefresh.description: Refresh libraries-coder-index.json from the resource configured for the selected region.

tools.name: coder_library_install
tools.description: Install one exact result from coder_library_search. Incompatible libraries are rejected unless allowIncompatible=true. Use that override only when the user explicitly requested this named library and confirmed after being told the supported/current architectures and compatible alternatives; if that confirmation UI times out, is skipped, or is unavailable, the original explicit install request remains authoritative and the override may be used, but the final response must disclose the incompatibility and alternatives. Never override compatibility for an Agent-selected library. The Coder Runtime downloads the ZIP URL from libraries-coder-index.json, verifies its declared size and SHA-256 checksum, safely extracts it into sketch/libraries, and returns the exact sourceDirectory and libraryRoots. Copy libraryRef and version exactly; do not use npm, Blockly library archives, or guessed paths.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef returned by coder_library_search.

allowIncompatible.description: Explicit compatibility override. Set true only for a user-named library after confirmation, or when that confirmation timed out, was skipped, or was unavailable while the user's original request explicitly required installing this library.

tools.name: coder_library_remove
tools.description: Remove one exact Aily Coder catalog library previously installed under sketch/libraries by coder_library_install. First search for the library and proceed only when installed=true and managed=true, then pass its exact libraryRef and installedVersion. Removal is resolved from the project-local managed receipt, so the current online index does not need to contain that installed version. Never remove a local, copied, malformed, or differently sourced library, and never change root package.json or node_modules.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef originally returned by coder_library_search.

version.description: Exact installedVersion returned by coder_library_search; do not substitute the catalog's selected version.
